name: BoxIntegral.le_hasIntegralVertices_of_isBounded
statement: Set (ι → ℝ)} (h : IsBounded s) : ∃ B : BoxIntegral.Box ι, hasIntegralVertices B ∧ s ≤ B

name: mem_smul_span_iff
statement: ι → ℝ} : v ∈ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • L ↔ ∀ i, n * v i ∈ Set.range (algebraMap ℤ ℝ)

name: tendsto_card_div_pow₂
statement: IsBounded s) (hs₄ : ∀ ⦃x y : ℝ⦄, 0 < x → x ≤ y → x • s ⊆ y • s) {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : x ≤ y) : Nat.card ↑(s ∩ x⁻¹ • L) ≤ Nat.card ↑(s ∩ y⁻¹ • L)

name: _root_.tendsto_tsum_div_pow_atTop_integral
statement: Continuous F) (hs₁ : IsBounded s) (hs₂ : MeasurableSet s) (hs₃ : volume (frontier s) = 0) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (∑' x : ↑(s ∩ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • L), F x) / n ^ card ι) atTop (nhds (∫ x in s, F x))

have_tree.name: h₁

name: tendsto_card_div_pow₅
statement: (fun x ↦ (Nat.card ↑(s ∩ (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)⁻¹ • L) : ℝ) / ⌊x⌋₊ ^ card ι * (⌊x⌋₊ / x) ^ card ι) =ᶠ[atTop] (fun x ↦ (Nat.card ↑(s ∩ (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)⁻¹ • L) : ℝ) / x ^ card ι)
